title: Unit 6 Consolidation: Nicaragua
goal: Review the lake and volcanoes, Darío, Sandino, the revolution and the 2018 protests, with the grammar you used to talk about them.
grammar: review: porque and por eso, fronting, si + hubiera, a pesar de, según and dijo que

items: I can review what I learned about Nicaragua, from Lake Cocibolca to the present day.
I can use *porque* and *por eso*, fronting, *si hubiera… habría…*, *a pesar de* and *según*.
I can put events from Darío to the 2023 exile in order.
I can say who said what about recent events.
I can give a reason with *porque* and a result with *por eso* (review).
I can put the important piece first, as in *Decisiva fue…*.
I can say what would have happened if something had been different, with *si hubiera… habría…* (review).
I can say that something went on in spite of a difficulty with *a pesar de*, and name my source with *según*.
